sentences.en: Since the girl is weeping, the sister is comforting her.

sentences.la: Cum nūntius aeger sit, in ātriō sedet.
sentences.en: Since the messenger is sick, he is sitting in the atrium.

sentences.la: Cum domina lacrimet, puellae silent.
sentences.en: Since the mistress is weeping, the girls are silent.

sentences.la: Puer clāmat, cum Dāvus eum reprehendat.
sentences.en: The boy is shouting, since Davus is blaming him.

sentences.la: Cum Mārcus fugiat, frāter eum quaerit.
sentences.en: Since Marcus is fleeing, the brother is looking for him.

sentences.la: Cum dominus absit, Iūlia trīstis est.
sentences.en: Since the owner is away, Julia is sad.

sentences.la: Cum Albīnus fessus sit, tamen laetus est.
sentences.en: Although Albinus is tired, he is nevertheless happy.

sentences.la: Amīcus plōrābat, cum Dāvus abesset.
sentences.en: The friend was crying, since Davus was away.

sentences.la: Incola tacēbat, cum magistrum metueret.
sentences.en: The inhabitant was silent, since he feared the teacher.

sentences.la: Iūlia Syram laudat, cum prūdēns sit.
sentences.en: Julia praises Syra, since she is sensible.

sentences.la: Cum puer lacrimet, pater eum cōnsōlātur.
sentences.en: Since the boy is weeping, the father is comforting him.

sentences.la: Cum incola fessus sit, in hortō cubat.
sentences.en: Since the inhabitant is tired, he is lying down in the garden.

sentences.la: Cum soror aegrōtet, puellae tacent.
sentences.en: Since the sister is ill, the girls are silent.

sentences.la: Fīlia lacrimat, cum domina eam persequātur.
sentences.en: The daughter is weeping, since the mistress is pursuing her.
